text:
Anya: Heads up, getting customer reports of missed pages for EU_1 cluster. PagerDuty shows no alerts fired for 3 mins.
incidentbot: detected outbound webhook failures to pagerbridge-eu: 503 from https://pagerbridge.internal/hooks/push, sample log: ```ERR sendWebhook 503 body: "upstream overloaded"```
Mike L: Did we push the pagerflow filter change earlier? I deployed #deploy-2026-03-18 at 10:15 UTC that updated route regex.
Kevin (Eng): yep that change added `route =~ /eu-(prod|staging)/ && !metadata.tags:beta` — could be matching too wide.
Anya: Can someone check automation-config `routes/pagerflow.yaml` and revert the regex? If it's blocking, pages will be auto-suppressed.
Kevin (Eng): pulling config now, `git rev-parse --short HEAD`: c4f3d9a
Kevin (Eng): the filter was intended to suppress beta routes but I see `metadata.tags:beta` was inverted. My bad.
incidentbot: runbook: https://runbooks.internal/incident/paging-automation-suppressor
Mike L: Reverting to previous commit `git revert c4f3d9a` and reloading automation.
Mike L: `./automationctl apply -f routes/pagerflow.yaml` -> CLI returns `OK`.
incidentbot: automation reload event recorded (evt id 84321). Outbound webhook errors reduced from 120/min -> 2/min.
Mike L: paging retries still showing some transient 503s to EU SMS gateway, retry logic doing work.
Ben (oncall): I got paged on the phone and checked PD, didn't see any escalations. I saw the delayed SMS deliveries in the logs.
Anya: Can we validate no missed customer pages? Check PD logs and SMS relay for the window 10:10-10:20 UTC.
Pagerbridge: queued 18 deliveries to EU phone gateway failed with 503 between 10:12-10:18 UTC, retried, 14 delivered on retry.
Kevin (Eng): sounds like partial delivery; creating post-incident checklist item to reconcile failed deliveries + who got alerted.
Mike L: Contacted Ben by phone to confirm no escalations were missed. Ben confirmed no customer-reported impact beyond delayed SMS.
Anya: Customer impact: delayed SMS/pager for ~6 minutes for a subset (EU SMS gateway transient). Escalation not required. Logging incident in PagerDuty as SEV3.
Kevin (Eng): adding mitigation: add unit test for route regex and a CI check to simulate suppression rules.
Anya: Good. After-action: schedule config review + quick rollback plan for automation changes. Closing thread when postmortem link is up.
Mike L: FYI: snippet that caused the issue: ```- match: 'route =~ /eu-/'
  - when: metadata.tags != beta``` — missing `not` operator parsing.
incidentbot: reminder: please run the automation pre-deploy checklist for future route edits (:memo:).
